boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented PLNU study environments, including outdoor seating, library areas, computer labs, and a residence-hall study room.

cards.title: Sunset Deck
cards.subtitle: Across from Bobby B’s, Point Loma campus
cards.notes: Bring portable work and use the outdoor setting; PLNU identifies the deck as a study spot and places it across from Bobby B’s.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus deck identified by PLNU for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU describes Sunset Deck as a place to study and states it is located across from Bobby B’s.
cards.source_title: 5 of the Best Spots to Study at PLNU
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; no specific access hours or reservation rules are stated on the source page.

cards.title: Greek Amphitheatre
cards.subtitle: Point Loma campus
cards.notes: Set up on the grass with materials suited to outdoor work; PLNU says the amphitheatre serves as a daytime study location.
cards.short_summary: A grass-seating amphitheatre PLNU documents for daytime study.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU states that the Greek Amphitheatre serves as a place to study during the day.
cards.source_title: 5 of the Best Spots to Study at PLNU
cards.access_notes: PLNU characterizes this as a daytime study location; no reservation or further access details are stated.

cards.title: Latter Hall Rooftop
cards.subtitle: Latter Hall, Point Loma campus
cards.notes: Use a rooftop table for independent work; PLNU specifically directs students seeking isolation to tables on Latter Hall’s rooftop.
cards.short_summary: Rooftop tables at PLNU’s science-complex building.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU identifies rooftop tables at Latter Hall as a study location.
cards.source_title: 5 of the Best Spots to Study at PLNU
cards.access_notes: Use only when the rooftop is open; the source does not publish hours or reservation requirements.

cards.title: Ryan Library
cards.subtitle: Ryan Library and Learning Center, Point Loma campus
cards.notes: Choose large tables, individual nooks, or the living-room section on floor one; PLNU also notes second-floor window seating.
cards.short_summary: A library study setting with several seating configurations.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU documents tables, individual study nooks, a living-room section, and second-floor window seating at Ryan Library.
cards.source_title: 5 of the Best Spots to Study at PLNU
cards.access_notes: PLNU patrons use their PLNU ID for library services; group-study-room keys are checked out through the library.

cards.title: McCullough Park
cards.subtitle: At Fermanian Business Center, Point Loma campus
cards.notes: Use the lawn or a table for outdoor reading and laptop work; PLNU identifies McCullough Park at the Fermanian Business Center.
cards.short_summary: A campus lawn-and-table study environment by the business center.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU identifies McCullough Park at the Fermanian Business Center as a study spot with grass and tables.
cards.source_title: 5 of the Best Spots to Study at PLNU
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; no specific access hours or reservation rules are stated on the source page.

cards.title: Wasson Collaborative Learning Lab
cards.subtitle: First floor, Ryan Library
cards.notes: Use this computer lab for technology-based coursework and printing; PLNU lists it for classes and general student use during library hours.
cards.short_summary: A named Ryan Library computer lab for general student use.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU lists the Wasson Collaborative Learning Lab on Ryan Library’s first floor and designates it for classes and general student use during library hours.
cards.access_notes: Located on Ryan Library’s first floor; designated for classes and general student use during library hours.

cards.title: Hughes Lab
cards.subtitle: First floor, Ryan Library
cards.notes: Plan computer-based coursework here during library hours; PLNU lists Hughes Lab among the first-floor labs available for general student use.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor Ryan Library computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU lists Hughes Lab on Ryan Library’s first floor and designates it for classes and general student use during library hours.
cards.access_notes: Located on Ryan Library’s first floor; designated for classes and general student use during library hours.

cards.title: Language Lab
cards.subtitle: First floor, Ryan Library
cards.notes: Bring digital coursework and use the lab’s computers during library hours; PLNU includes the Language Lab in its general-student-use labs.
cards.short_summary: A named Ryan Library computer lab for class and general use.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU lists the Language Lab on Ryan Library’s first floor and designates it for classes and general student use during library hours.
cards.access_notes: Located on Ryan Library’s first floor; designated for classes and general student use during library hours.

cards.title: Main Lab
cards.subtitle: First floor, Ryan Library
cards.notes: Use the lab for computer work or printing during library hours; PLNU lists Main Lab among the Ryan Library labs for general student use.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor library computer lab with printing available.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU lists Main Lab on Ryan Library’s first floor, designates it for general student use during library hours, and states printing is available in Ryan Library computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Located on Ryan Library’s first floor; designated for classes and general student use during library hours.

cards.title: Klassen Hall Study Room
cards.subtitle: Klassen Hall, Point Loma campus
cards.notes: If you live in Klassen, use its designated study room for focused work; the hall also has large lounges on the first and third floors.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall study room documented by PLNU.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU states that Klassen Hall features a study room and large lounges on its first and third floors.
cards.access_notes: Located in a freshman residence hall; use is appropriately limited to residents and their authorized guests under housing rules.
